details:
- CVE-2026-56444: the serve-expired callback discards only UDP replies and
  counts a discarded reply out of the reply addresses in use, so
  discard-timeout combined with serve-expired-client-timeout no longer
  degrades the service
- CVE-2026-82720: pop each reply from the reply list before it is sent or
  dropped and clear the DoH stream references of all streams of the session
  on cleanup, which fixes a use-after-free in the DoH stream cleanup path
- CVE-2024-33655: follow-up to the DNSBomb fix: drop the reference to a
  discarded reply from the DoH stream (use-after-free), allow the two
  arguments of wait-limit-netblock and wait-limit-cookie-netblock, discard
  only UDP replies and no longer those of open TCP, TLS and DoH streams,
  and count discarded replies out of the reply addresses in use so the
  server does not start to drop all new queries
- CVE-2026-96405: limit the DNS name decompression work per message: a
  budget of 2048 compression pointer follows for a parsed reply and of
  128000 for a received zone transfer packet, parsing fails when it is used
  up
- CVE-2025-5994: follow-up to the earlier fix, the subnet module no longer
  lets the sub request of a CD query skip validation, and does not answer
  from an unchecked subnet cache entry when validation is required, so
  unvalidated answers are no longer served from the subnet cache
- CVE-2026-50106: an unsigned parent zone that denies the name of a
  subdomain of a configured trust anchor island now makes the answer bogus,
  and a denial from a signed parent must be secure, so no insecure NXDOMAIN
  is accepted there
- CVE-2026-35501: do not take the DS-query shortcut in the validator for an
  NSEC query that is not at the apex, which let an attacker-controlled NSEC
  bypass a configured island trust anchor under an insecure parent
- CVE-2026-109125: when unwanted-reply-threshold clears the cache, also
  close the pending queries on the UDP port that received the unwanted
  replies, so that the clearing no longer reveals the port
- CVE-2026-77955: do not answer from an auth zone with zonemd-check, and do
  not write its zone file, while the ZONEMD verification of a new zone
  version is still pending
